                       SOUTHWESTERN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY’S
                            RESPONSE TO SOAH ORDER NO. 5

          Pursuant to State Office of Administrative Hearings (SOAH) Order No. 5, dated March 20,

2026, Southwestern Electric Power Company (SWEPCO or the Company) provides its exhibit list,

list of witnesses it intends to present, and list of witnesses for whom SWEPCO waives cross-

examination. Additionally, the Company provides a list of the individuals who have signed the

Protective Order certification to date.

                                          I.   WITNESSES

          To the extent cross-examination of any SWEPCO witness is not waived by other parties,

SWEPCO will present its direct and rebuttal witnesses in the order identified on its exhibit list

below.

                                      II.      EXHIBIT LIST

          SWEPCO will offer the following exhibits.

  Exhibit       Description
      1         Application for Authority to Amend Tariffs for Retail Service
      2         Direct Testimony of Melissa A. Gage (adopted by Lynn Ferry-Nelson)
                HSPM Direct Testimony and Exhibit of Melissa A. Gage (adopted by Lynn Ferry-
     2A

      3         Rebuttal Testimony of Lynn Ferry-Nelson
     3A         Workpapers to the Rebuttal Testimony of Lynn Ferry-Nelson

      II.       WITNESSES FOR WHOM SWEPCO WAIVES CROSS EXAMINATION

            At this time, SWEPCO has determined that it does not intend to cross examine Commission

Staff witness Adrian Narvaez; however, to the extent that other parties do not waive cross

examination of Mr. Narvaez and he is cross-examined, SWEPCO reserves the right to cross-

examine him as well.

               III.     ORDER OF PRESENTATION AND CROSS-EXAMINATION

            SWEPCO intends to present its direct testimony to begin the hearing and to present its

rebuttal testimony after the presentation of the intervenor and Staff testimony. SWEPCO has not

been informed of the order of cross-examination of SWEPCO’s witnesses or the presentation by

intervenors and Staff of their respective direct cases. SWEPCO requests that it be allowed the

opportunity to cross-examine intervenor and Staff witnesses after the other parties have concluded

their cross-examination.

                      IV.      PARTIES SUBJECT TO THE PROTECTIVE ORDER

the Hearing on the Merits, the following individuals have signed the Protective Order certification
